title: Standard Azure Linux Repo Layout
description: The fixed channel x kind x arch matrix used to describe a published Azure Linux RPM repository tree (the layout consumed by `dnf-with-azl-repos`, `synthesize-repodata.py`, and the `--repo-prefix` mode of the test suite).

version.description: Schema version. Bumped when the structure changes in a way that breaks existing loaders.

channels.description: The set of allowed channel names (each subrepo's `channel` must be one of these).

name.description: Stable short identifier for this sub-repo (used to build dnf repo IDs etc.). Must be unique across the array.

channel.description: Which channel this sub-repo belongs to (must appear in `channels` above).

kind.description: Content kind. `binary` = main binary RPMs; `debuginfo` = debuginfo + debugsource; `srpm` = source RPMs.

per_arch.description: True if the sub-repo is published per arch (URL contains `$basearch`); false if arch-agnostic (e.g. srpms).

subpath.description: Path under the repo prefix. Must contain `$basearch` iff `per_arch` is true; loaders enforce this invariant.
